subject: Fix the coefficient value of x1, estimate the coefficient of x2

messages.author: 10edd14eaa782c14
messages.subject: Fix the coefficient value of x1, estimate the coefficient of x2
parts:
Hello R-INLA users,

I am wondering if it's possible to do the following.

y = 3 + 2*x1 + a*x2

x1 and x2 are my covariates, and I want to keep the intercept fixed at 3 and the coefficient of x1 fixed at 2. Can I estimate only a, the coefficient of x2?

This is for a model specified under inla.coxph.

Thank you.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Fix the coefficient value of x1, estimate the coefficient of x2
parts:
You can define this as an offset using

y ~ -1 + offset(intercept) + offset(twox1)

where

intercept = rep(3, n)
twox1 = 2*x1
